descriptor: Outdoor and workwear store with fast checkout

voice.summary: Fieldwork keeps checkout copy short and calm so people never wonder what happens next. Every step says what it needs, why, and what it will cost in pounds.
dos: Label every field with the exact thing needed
State totals, delivery and dates in plain numbers
Explain an error in the field where it occurred
donts: Do not use urgency timers or pressure
Never hide delivery costs until the last step

taglines: Gear for the job, paid for simply
boilerplate: Fieldwork is a UK outdoor and workwear store with a clear four-step checkout, honest delivery options and an order summary that always shows the real total.

microcopy.success: Order placed. A receipt is on its way.
microcopy.error: That card number looks wrong. Check it and try again.

logo.note: A bag mark says store at a glance and suits a no-nonsense checkout.
